description: Queensland Transport and Roads Investment Program (QTRIP)–2021 22 to 2024 25 (series on Queensland Government Open Data Portal) is a series of datasets listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. The Queensland Transport and Roads Investment Program 2021-22 to 2024-25 (QTRIP) outlines the Department of Transport and Main Roads current and planned investment in road and transport infrastructure across Queensland over a four-year period. For more information, please visit the Department of Transport and Main Roads website. Coverage: Queensland. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are TMR, infrastructure, project, qtrip. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, txt. The portal shows 2021-06-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
